app.title: Elena — Road to the BFA
app.tagline: Every deadline, audition, and requirement in one place.

nyc.label: New York City area
nyc.note: Five schools audition in/around NYC (Jan–Mar). One or two well-timed trips can cover several. Purchase is Westchester, ~35 min from Grand Central.

socal.label: Southern California
socal.note: USC (LA) and Chapman (Orange) are ~40 miles apart — combinable into one trip.

boston.label: Boston
boston.note: Boston Conservatory offers a live-online audition — may avoid the flight.

tucson.label: Tucson, AZ
tucson.note: Video-only audition accepted, but an in-person Sept/Jan date (before ~Feb 1) preserves first-year Dance Merit talent aid.

lastRefresh.summary: Re-verified all 9 schools' stored source URLs against live pages. Arizona's base application moved to the Common App for Fall 2027 (Future Wildcat now supplement-only); Pace's prescreen photo spec was refined; Boston Conservatory's post-solo faculty conversation was clarified to cover both dance tracks. USC Kaufman's Portfolio page has gone blank ("check back soon") pending its Fall 2027 refresh. Everything else re-confirmed unchanged. Marymount/Northeastern audition mechanics remain unpublished post-merger (Acceptd portal still bot-blocked); Purchase's domestic-video-audition eligibility remains unresolved.
